verdict.rationale: Trilegal is an Indian full-service law firm, not a software product that holds user data. User-facing controls for data retention and deletion do not fit this kind of product. Its DPDPA advisory content and compliance assessment tool are legal services about data protection, not a retention or deletion control for users, so the axis does not flip to applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
